title: Miso tofu and mushroom soup
summary: Miso tofu and mushroom soup is a japanese dinner built around firm tofu and chestnut mushrooms, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Miso tofu and mushroom soup. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add firm tofu and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and chestnut mushrooms.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until rice miso paste is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Miso tofu and mushroom soup before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Miso tofu and mushroom soup.
